decision_cruda.rationale: LH-10 is idle at the workshop (no home loss). Send it to E569-07 (10.5 g/t, 164 t, Este stockpile nearly empty, trucks not limiting). It arrives in 0.49 h and mucks about 27.5 t/h until LH-02 is back (likely 13:30), about 80 t or 28 oz. LH-08 is a cheap preparation heading (1.3 oz/h). Lend it to C512-04 (5.8 g/t, 238 t, about 5.6 oz/h at 30 t/h) until LH-06 returns (likely 11:30). That is a small net gain of about 3 to 4 oz. I left LH-09 (critical path, 4.2 oz/h) alone. Radio and CMMS agree on both failures, so no confirmation is needed.
